title: NIST WebBook: Ammonia gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 2 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Ammonia. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Ammonia (CAS 7664-41-7) print: -45.94 ± 0.35 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Cox, Wagman, et al., 1984, comment: CODATA Review value (experimental or compiled row) | -45.90 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Chase, 1998, comment: Data last reviewed in June, 1977 (calculated or reviewed row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
